title: Reuse the operation's one source observation for imported evidence on the same named root (no second source read in evaluate/done)
outcome: Reuse the operation's one source observation for imported evidence on the same named root (no second source read in evaluate/done)
acceptance: When evaluate or done handles registered and imported evidence on the same active named root, the operation takes one source observation and passes it to the imported-evidence path when the root binding matches exactly; writer-side validation is unchanged
A behaviour test shows such an operation makes one source read, not two, and gives the same verdicts as before
